verses.original: וַיְהִ֞י כַּאֲשֶׁ֧ר שָׁמַ֣ע סַנְבַלַּ֗ט כִּֽי־ אֲנַ֤חְנוּ בוֹנִים֙ אֶת־ הַ֣חוֹמָ֔ה וַיִּ֣חַר ל֔וֹ וַיִּכְעַ֖ס הַרְבֵּ֑ה וַיַּלְעֵ֖ג עַל־ הַיְּהוּדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: yə·hî ka·’ă·šer šā·ma‘ san·ḇal·laṭ kî- ’ă·naḥ·nū ḇō·w·nîm ’eṯ- ha·ḥō·w·māh way·yi·ḥar lōw way·yiḵ·‘as har·bêh way·yal·‘êḡ ‘al- hay·yə·hū·ḏîm
verses.literal: Now when Sanballat heard that we were rebuilding the wall he was furious and filled with indignation . . . He ridiculed . . . the Jews
verses.literalPt: Mas, tendo Sambalá ouvido que nós edificávamos o muro, ardeu em ira, encolerizou-se em extremo e escarneceu dos judeus.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר׀ לִפְנֵ֣י אֶחָ֗יו וְחֵיל֙ שֹֽׁמְר֔וֹן וַיֹּ֕אמֶר מָ֛ה הַיְּהוּדִ֥ים הָאֲמֵלָלִ֖ים עֹשִׂ֑ים הֲיַעַזְב֨וּ לָהֶ֤ם הֲיִזְבָּ֙חוּ֙ הַיְכַלּ֣וּ בַיּ֔וֹם הַיְחַיּ֧וּ אֶת־ הָאֲבָנִ֛ים מֵעֲרֵמ֥וֹת הֶעָפָ֖ר וְהֵ֥מָּה שְׂרוּפֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lip̄·nê ’e·ḥāw wə·ḥêl šō·mə·rō·wn way·yō·mer māh hay·yə·hū·ḏîm hā·’ă·mê·lā·lîm ‘ō·śîm hă·ya·‘az·ḇū lā·hem hă·yiz·bā·ḥū hay·ḵal·lū ḇay·yō·wm hay·ḥay·yū ’eṯ- hā·’ă·ḇā·nîm mê·‘ă·rê·mō·wṯ he·‘ā·p̄ār wə·hêm·māh śə·rū·p̄ō·wṯ
verses.literal: before his associates and the army of Samaria . . . saying What are these feeble Jews doing Can they restore the wall by themselves Will they offer sacrifices Will they complete it in a day Can they bring these burnt stones back to life from the mounds of rubble
verses.literalPt: Disse diante de seus irmãos e do exército de Samaria: Que fazem estes fracos judeus? Fortificar-se-ão? Oferecerão sacrifícios? Acabarão a sua obra num dia? Vivificarão as pedras de montões de ruínas e queimadas a fogo?

verses.original: וְטוֹבִיָּ֥ה הָעַמֹּנִ֖י אֶצְל֑וֹ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר גַּ֚ם אֲשֶׁר־ הֵ֣ם בּוֹנִ֔ים אִם־ יַעֲלֶ֣ה שׁוּעָ֔ל וּפָרַ֖ץ חוֹמַ֥ת אַבְנֵיהֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ṭō·w·ḇî·yāh hā·‘am·mō·nî ’eṣ·lōw way·yō·mer gam ’ă·šer- hêm bō·w·nîm ’im- ya·‘ă·leh šū·‘āl ū·p̄ā·raṣ ḥō·w·maṯ ’aḇ·nê·hem
verses.literal: Then Tobiah the Ammonite who was beside him said If even a fox were to climb up on what they are building it would break down their wall of stones
verses.literalPt: Ora, Tobias, amonita, estava do lado dele e disse: Deixai-os edificar! Se uma raposa for saltar o seu muro de pedras, derrubá-lo-á.

verses.original: שְׁמַ֤ע אֱלֹהֵ֙ינוּ֙ כִּֽי־ הָיִ֣ינוּ בוּזָ֔ה וְהָשֵׁ֥ב חֶרְפָּתָ֖ם אֶל־ רֹאשָׁ֑ם וּתְנֵ֥ם לְבִזָּ֖ה בְּאֶ֥רֶץ שִׁבְיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šə·ma‘ ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū kî- hā·yî·nū ḇū·zāh wə·hā·šêḇ ḥer·pā·ṯām ’el- rō·šām ū·ṯə·nêm lə·ḇiz·zāh bə·’e·reṣ šiḇ·yāh
verses.literal: Hear us O God for we are despised Turn their scorn back upon their own heads and let them be taken as plunder to a land of captivity
verses.literalPt: Ouve, Deus nosso, pois somos desprezados. Faze recair o seu opróbrio sobre as suas cabeças e entrega-os à depredação numa terra de cativeiro.

verses.original: וְאַל־ תְּכַס֙ עַל־ עֲוֺנָ֔ם וְחַטָּאתָ֖ם מִלְּפָנֶ֣יךָ אַל־ תִּמָּחֶ֑ה כִּ֥י הִכְעִ֖יסוּ לְנֶ֥גֶד הַבּוֹנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’al- tə·ḵas ‘al- ‘ă·wō·nām wə·ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯām mil·lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā ’al- tim·mā·ḥeh kî hiḵ·‘î·sū lə·ne·ḡeḏ hab·bō·w·nîm
verses.literal: Do not cover up . . . their iniquity or let their sin be blotted out from Your sight . . . for they have provoked . . . the builders
verses.literalPt: Não cubras as suas iniquidades, e não se apague o seu pecado de diante de ti, pois te provocaram à ira na presença dos que edificavam.

verses.original: וַנִּבְנֶה֙ אֶת־ הַ֣חוֹמָ֔ה וַתִּקָּשֵׁ֥ר כָּל־ הַחוֹמָ֖ה עַד־ חֶצְיָ֑הּ וַיְהִ֧י לֵ֦ב לָעָ֖ם לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃פ
verses.transliteration: wan·niḇ·neh ’eṯ- ha·ḥō·w·māh wat·tiq·qā·šêr kāl- ha·ḥō·w·māh ‘aḏ- ḥeṣ·yāh way·hî lêḇ lā·‘ām la·‘ă·śō·wṯ
verses.literal: So we rebuilt the wall until all of it was joined together up to half its height for the people had a mind to work
verses.literalPt: Edificamos o muro, e todo o muro foi acabado até a metade da sua altura. Pois o povo tinha desejo de trabalhar.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י כַאֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁמַ֣ע סַנְבַלַּ֡ט וְ֠טוֹבִיָּה וְהָעַרְבִ֨ים וְהָעַמֹּנִ֜ים וְהָאַשְׁדּוֹדִ֗ים כִּֽי־ עָלְתָ֤ה אֲרוּכָה֙ לְחֹמ֣וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם כִּי־ הֵחֵ֥לּוּ הַפְּרֻצִ֖ים לְהִסָּתֵ֑ם וַיִּ֥חַר לָהֶ֖ם מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḵa·’ă·šer šā·ma‘ san·ḇal·laṭ wə·ṭō·w·ḇî·yāh wə·hā·‘ar·ḇîm wə·hā·‘am·mō·nîm wə·hā·’aš·dō·w·ḏîm kî- ‘ā·lə·ṯāh ’ă·rū·ḵāh lə·ḥō·mō·wṯ yə·rū·šā·lim kî- hê·ḥêl·lū hap·pə·ru·ṣîm lə·his·sā·ṯêm way·yi·ḥar lā·hem mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: When Sanballat and Tobiah together with the Arabs Ammonites and Ashdodites heard that the repair to the walls of Jerusalem was progressing and that . . . the gaps were being closed they were furious
verses.literalPt: Mas, quando Sambalá, Tobias, os árabes, os amonitas e os asdoditas ouviram que a reparação dos muros de Jerusalém ia adiante e que as brechas começavam a ser fechadas, ficaram sobremodo irados.

verses.original: וַיִּקְשְׁר֤וּ כֻלָּם֙ יַחְדָּ֔ו לָב֖וֹא לְהִלָּחֵ֣ם בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְלַעֲשׂ֥וֹת ל֖וֹ תּוֹעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·šə·rū ḵul·lām yaḥ·dāw lā·ḇō·w lə·hil·lā·ḥêm bî·rū·šā·lim wə·la·‘ă·śō·wṯ lōw tō·w·‘āh
verses.literal: and all of them conspired . . . to come and fight against Jerusalem and create a hindrance
verses.literalPt: Ajuntaram-se todos de comum acordo para virem e pelejarem contra Jerusalém e fazerem que houvesse confusão ali.

verses.original: וַנִּתְפַּלֵּ֖ל אֶל־ אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וַנַּעֲמִ֨יד מִשְׁמָ֧ר עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם יוֹמָ֥ם וָלַ֖יְלָה מִפְּנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wan·niṯ·pal·lêl ’el- ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū wan·na·‘ă·mîḏ miš·mār ‘ă·lê·hem yō·w·mām wā·lay·lāh mip·pə·nê·hem
verses.literal: So we prayed to our God and posted a guard against them . . . day and night
verses.literalPt: Porém oramos ao nosso Deus e, pelo receio que nos inspiravam, pusemos guardas contra eles de dia e de noite.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוּדָ֗ה כָּשַׁל֙ כֹּ֣חַ הַסַּבָּ֔ל וְהֶעָפָ֖ר הַרְבֵּ֑ה וַאֲנַ֙חְנוּ֙ לֹ֣א נוּכַ֔ל לִבְנ֖וֹת בַּחוֹמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yə·hū·ḏāh kā·šal kō·aḥ has·sab·bāl wə·he·‘ā·p̄ār har·bêh wa·’ă·naḥ·nū lō nū·ḵal liḇ·nō·wṯ ba·ḥō·w·māh
verses.literal: Meanwhile, the people of Judah said The strength of the laborer fails and there is so much rubble that we will never be able to rebuild the wall
verses.literalPt: Então, disse Judá: Já desfaleceram as forças dos carregadores, e há muito escombro a remover, de maneira que não podemos edificar o muro.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ צָרֵ֗ינוּ לֹ֤א יֵדְעוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א יִרְא֔וּ עַ֛ד אֲשֶׁר־ נָב֥וֹא אֶל־ תּוֹכָ֖ם וַהֲרַגְנ֑וּם וְהִשְׁבַּ֖תְנוּ אֶת־ הַמְּלָאכָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ṣā·rê·nū lō yê·ḏə·‘ū wə·lō yir·’ū ‘aḏ ’ă·šer- nā·ḇō·w ’el- tō·w·ḵām wa·hă·raḡ·nūm wə·hiš·baṯ·nū ’eṯ- ham·mə·lā·ḵāh
verses.literal: And our enemies said Before they know or see a thing we will come into their midst kill them and put an end to the work
verses.literalPt: Disseram os nossos adversários: Não saberão, nem verão, até que entremos no meio deles, e os matemos, e façamos cessar a obra.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ כַּאֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֣אוּ הַיְּהוּדִ֔ים הַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים אֶצְלָ֑ם וַיֹּ֤אמְרוּ לָ֙נוּ֙ עֶ֣שֶׂר פְּעָמִ֔ים מִכָּל־ הַמְּקֹמ֖וֹת אֲשֶׁר־ תָּשׁ֥וּבוּ עָלֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ka·’ă·šer- bā·’ū hay·yə·hū·ḏîm hay·yō·šə·ḇîm ’eṣ·lām way·yō·mə·rū lā·nū ‘e·śer pə·‘ā·mîm mik·kāl ham·mə·qō·mō·wṯ ’ă·šer- tā·šū·ḇū ‘ā·lê·nū
verses.literal: At that time the Jews who lived nearby came and told us ten times over Wherever . . . you turn they will attack us
verses.literalPt: Vindo os judeus de todos os lugares onde habitavam entre eles, disseram-nos dez vezes: Deveis voltar para nós.

verses.original: וָֽאַעֲמִ֞יד מִֽתַּחְתִּיּ֧וֹת לַמָּק֛וֹם מֵאַחֲרֵ֥י לַחוֹמָ֖ה בַּצְּחִחִיִּים וָֽאַעֲמִ֤יד אֶת־ הָעָם֙ לְמִשְׁפָּח֔וֹת עִם־ חַרְבֹתֵיהֶ֛ם רָמְחֵיהֶ֖ם וְקַשְּׁתֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’a·‘ă·mîḏ mit·taḥ·tî·yō·wṯ lam·mā·qō·wm mê·’a·ḥă·rê la·ḥō·w·māh baṣ·ṣə·ḥi·ḥī·yīm wā·’a·‘ă·mîḏ ’eṯ- hā·‘ām lə·miš·pā·ḥō·wṯ ‘im- ḥar·ḇō·ṯê·hem rā·mə·ḥê·hem wə·qaš·šə·ṯō·ṯê·hem
verses.literal: So I stationed men behind the lowest sections of the wall at the vulnerable areas I stationed them by families with their swords spears and bows
verses.literalPt: Portanto, nos lugares mais baixos do espaço por detrás do muro, nos lugares abertos, pus o povo segundo as suas famílias com as suas espadas, com as suas lanças e com os seus arcos.

verses.original: וָאֵ֣רֶא וָאָק֗וּם וָאֹמַ֞ר אֶל־ הַחֹרִ֤ים וְאֶל־ הַסְּגָנִים֙ וְאֶל־ יֶ֣תֶר הָעָ֔ם אַל־ תִּֽירְא֖וּ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֑ם אֶת־ אֲדֹנָ֞י הַגָּד֤וֹל וְהַנּוֹרָא֙ זְכֹ֔רוּ וְהִֽלָּחֲמ֗וּ עַל־ אֲחֵיכֶם֙ בְּנֵיכֶ֣ם וּבְנֹתֵיכֶ֔ם נְשֵׁיכֶ֖ם וּבָתֵּיכֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: wā·’ê·re wā·’ā·qūm wā·’ō·mar ’el- ha·ḥō·rîm wə·’el- has·sə·ḡā·nîm wə·’el- ye·ṯer hā·‘ām ’al- tî·rə·’ū mip·pə·nê·hem ’eṯ- ’ă·ḏō·nāy hag·gā·ḏō·wl wə·han·nō·w·rā zə·ḵō·rū wə·hil·lā·ḥă·mū ‘al- ’ă·ḥê·ḵem bə·nê·ḵem ū·ḇə·nō·ṯê·ḵem nə·šê·ḵem ū·ḇāt·tê·ḵem
verses.literal: After I had made an inspection I stood up and said to the nobles . . . the officials . . . and the rest of the people Do not be afraid of them Remember the Lord who is great and awesome and fight for your brothers your sons and your daughters your wives and your homes
verses.literalPt: Olhei, levantei-me e disse aos nobres e magistrados, e ao resto do povo: Não tenhais medo deles; lembrai-vos dos Senhor, que é grande e terrível, e pelejai pelos vossos irmãos, vossos filhos, vossas filhas, vossas mulheres e vossas casas.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֞י כַּֽאֲשֶׁר־ שָׁמְע֤וּ אוֹיְבֵ֙ינוּ֙ כִּי־ נ֣וֹדַֽע לָ֔נוּ וַיָּ֥פֶר הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת־ עֲצָתָ֑ם וַנָּשׁוּב כֻּלָּ֙נוּ֙ אֶל־ הַ֣חוֹמָ֔ה אִ֖ישׁ אֶל־ מְלַאכְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ka·’ă·šer- šā·mə·‘ū ’ō·wy·ḇê·nū kî- nō·w·ḏa‘ lā·nū way·yā·p̄er hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- ‘ă·ṣā·ṯām wan·nå̄·šūḇ kul·lā·nū ’el- ha·ḥō·w·māh ’îš ’el- mə·laḵ·tōw
verses.literal: When our enemies heard that we were aware of their scheme and that God had frustrated it each of us returned to his own work on the wall
verses.literalPt: Ouvindo os nossos inimigos que nós tínhamos sido avisados, e tendo Deus reduzido a nada o conselho deles, voltamos todos nós para o muro, cada um para sua obra.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ מִן־ הַיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא חֲצִ֣י נְעָרַי֮ עֹשִׂ֣ים בַּמְּלָאכָה֒ וְחֶצְיָ֗ם מַחֲזִיקִים֙ וְהָרְמָחִ֣ים הַמָּגִנִּ֔ים וְהַקְּשָׁת֖וֹת וְהַשִּׁרְיֹנִ֑ים וְהַ֨שָּׂרִ֔ים אַחֲרֵ֖י כָּל־ בֵּ֥ית יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî min- hay·yō·wm ha·hū ḥă·ṣî nə·‘ā·ray ‘ō·śîm bam·mə·lā·ḵāh wə·ḥeṣ·yām ma·ḥă·zî·qîm wə·hā·rə·mā·ḥîm ham·mā·ḡin·nîm wə·haq·qə·šā·ṯō·wṯ wə·haš·šir·yō·nîm wə·haś·śā·rîm ’a·ḥă·rê kāl- bêṯ yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: And from that day on half of my servants did the work while the other half held spears shields bows and armor The officers stationed themselves behind all the people of Judah
verses.literalPt: Desde aquele dia em diante, metade dos meus servos trabalhava na obra, e metade deles tinha as lanças, os escudos, os arcos e as couraças; e os chefes estavam atrás de toda a casa de Judá.

verses.original: הַבּוֹנִ֧ים בַּחוֹמָ֛ה וְהַנֹּשְׂאִ֥ים בַּסֶּ֖בֶל עֹמְשִׂ֑ים בְּאַחַ֤ת יָדוֹ֙ עֹשֶׂ֣ה בַמְּלָאכָ֔ה וְאַחַ֖ת מַחֲזֶ֥קֶת הַשָּֽׁלַח׃
verses.transliteration: hab·bō·w·nîm ba·ḥō·w·māh wə·han·nō·śə·’îm bas·se·ḇel ‘ō·mə·śîm bə·’a·ḥaṯ yā·ḏōw ‘ō·śeh ḇam·mə·lā·ḵāh wə·’a·ḥaṯ ma·ḥă·ze·qeṯ haš·šā·laḥ
verses.literal: who were rebuilding the wall The laborers who carried materials . . . worked . . . with one hand and held a weapon with the other
verses.literalPt: Os que edificavam o muro e os carregadores que sobre si mesmos punham as cargas, cada um com uma das mãos trabalhava na obra e com a outra segurava a sua arma;

verses.original: וְהַ֨בּוֹנִ֔ים אִ֥ישׁ חַרְבּ֛וֹ אֲסוּרִ֥ים עַל־ מָתְנָ֖יו וּבוֹנִ֑ים וְהַתּוֹקֵ֥עַ בַּשּׁוֹפָ֖ר אֶצְלִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hab·bō·w·nîm ’îš ḥar·bōw ’ă·sū·rîm ‘al- mā·ṯə·nāw ū·ḇō·w·nîm wə·hat·tō·w·qê·a‘ baš·šō·w·p̄ār ’eṣ·lî
verses.literal: And each of the builders worked with his sword strapped at his side But the trumpeter . . . stayed beside me
verses.literalPt: e os que edificavam, cada um tinha a sua espada à cinta, e assim edificaram. Aquele que tocava a trombeta estava ao meu lado.

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֞ר אֶל־ הַחֹרִ֤ים וְאֶל־ הַסְּגָנִים֙ וְאֶל־ יֶ֣תֶר הָעָ֔ם הַמְּלָאכָ֥ה הַרְבֵּ֖ה וּרְחָבָ֑ה וַאֲנַ֗חְנוּ נִפְרָדִים֙ עַל־ הַ֣חוֹמָ֔ה רְחוֹקִ֖ים אִ֥ישׁ מֵאָחִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mar ’el- ha·ḥō·rîm wə·’el- has·sə·ḡā·nîm wə·’el- ye·ṯer hā·‘ām ham·mə·lā·ḵāh har·bêh ū·rə·ḥā·ḇāh wa·’ă·naḥ·nū nip̄·rā·ḏîm ‘al- ha·ḥō·w·māh rə·ḥō·w·qîm ’îš mê·’ā·ḥîw
verses.literal: Then I said to the nobles . . . the officials . . . and the rest of the people The work is great and extensive and we are spread out far from one another along the wall
verses.literalPt: Disse eu aos nobres, aos magistrados e ao resto do povo: A obra é grande e extensa, e nós estamos no muro muito separados uns dos outros;

verses.original: בִּמְק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר תִּשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֶת־ ק֣וֹל הַשּׁוֹפָ֔ר שָׁ֖מָּה תִּקָּבְצ֣וּ אֵלֵ֑ינוּ אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ יִלָּ֥חֶם לָֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: bim·qō·wm ’ă·šer tiš·mə·‘ū ’eṯ- qō·wl haš·šō·w·p̄ār šām·māh tiq·qā·ḇə·ṣū ’ê·lê·nū ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū yil·lā·ḥem lā·nū
verses.literal: Wherever you hear the sound of the horn rally to us there Our God will fight for us
verses.literalPt: em qualquer lugar em que ouvirdes o som da trombeta, correi ali a nós. O nosso Deus pelejará por nós.

verses.original: וַאֲנַ֖חְנוּ עֹשִׂ֣ים בַּמְּלָאכָ֑ה וְחֶצְיָ֗ם מַחֲזִיקִים֙ בָּֽרְמָחִ֔ים מֵעֲל֣וֹת הַשַּׁ֔חַר עַ֖ד צֵ֥את הַכּוֹכָבִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·naḥ·nū ‘ō·śîm bam·mə·lā·ḵāh wə·ḥeṣ·yām ma·ḥă·zî·qîm bā·rə·mā·ḥîm mê·‘ă·lō·wṯ haš·ša·ḥar ‘aḏ ṣêṯ hak·kō·w·ḵā·ḇîm
verses.literal: So we continued the work while half of the men held spears from the break of dawn until the stars came out
verses.literalPt: Assim trabalhávamos na obra; e metade deles tinha as lanças empunhadas desde o raiar do dia até que saíam as estrelas.

verses.original: גַּ֣ם בָּעֵ֤ת הַהִיא֙ אָמַ֣רְתִּי לָעָ֔ם אִ֣ישׁ וְנַעֲר֔וֹ יָלִ֖ינוּ בְּת֣וֹךְ יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְהָֽיוּ־ לָ֧נוּ הַלַּ֛יְלָה מִשְׁמָ֖ר וְהַיּ֥וֹם מְלָאכָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: gam bā·‘êṯ ha·hî ’ā·mar·tî lā·‘ām ’îš wə·na·‘ă·rōw yā·lî·nū bə·ṯō·wḵ yə·rū·šā·lim wə·hā·yū- lā·nū hal·lay·lāh miš·mār wə·hay·yō·wm mə·lā·ḵāh
verses.literal: At that time I also said to the people Let every man and his servant spend the night inside Jerusalem so that they can stand guard by night and work by day
verses.literalPt: Também, ao mesmo tempo, disse eu ao povo: Pouse cada um juntamente com os seus servos em Jerusalém, para que, à noite, nos sirvam de guardas e para que, de dia, trabalhem.

verses.original: וְאֵ֨ין אֲנִ֜י וְאַחַ֣י וּנְעָרַ֗י וְאַנְשֵׁ֤י הַמִּשְׁמָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַחֲרַ֔י אֵין־ אֲנַ֥חְנוּ פֹשְׁטִ֖ים בְּגָדֵ֑ינוּ אִ֖ישׁ שִׁלְח֥וֹ הַמָּֽיִם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’ên ’ă·nî wə·’a·ḥay ū·nə·‘ā·ray wə·’an·šê ham·miš·mār ’ă·šer ’a·ḥă·ray ’ên- ’ă·naḥ·nū p̄ō·šə·ṭîm bə·ḡā·ḏê·nū ’îš šil·ḥōw ham·mā·yim
verses.literal: So neither I nor my brothers nor my servants . . . nor the guards with me . . . . . . changed out of our clothes each carried his weapon even to go for water
verses.literalPt: Assim, nem eu, nem meus irmãos, nem os meus servos, nem os da guarda que me acompanhavam, largávamos os nossos vestidos, cada um ia com a sua arma para a água.
